name: Hotdog
blurb: Every known world spawn for Hotdog, grouped by region. Directions and photos are added by hand.

containers.note: Hotdog is placed directly in the world at diners, grills and picnic spots (fixed spawns); a small number of food containers can also hold one.

consumption.note: Hotdog is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
